answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks using hardware attestation linked through an endorsement vine. Each agent must run inside a secure enclave, submitting proofs signed by silicon root keys. Instead of deploying a gale of hollow personas across a server tundra, an attacker must procure genuine physical processors, incurring verifiable hardware costs per identity. However, reliance on proprietary chip foundries introduces centralized trust and vulnerability to side-channel exploits.
